summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for updating Sheep Weather with:
1. Working auto-download APK button and in-app GitHub update checker in the Location pop-out drawer.
2. Redesigned Settings menu moved inside the Location pop-out drawer with new toggles (Turn off AI features, Celsius vs Fahrenheit, Auto/Light/Dark theme, Cartoon vs Photo style).
3. Cleaned-up Main Screen top bar removing clutter (Day/Night, Cartoon/Photo, Car Mode, and Settings icons moved).
4. Preserved native Android Auto CarAppService capability while removing the in-app car mode button.
5. Splash screen startup sync that keeps the animation running until initial weather data has loaded.
